evals.name: latest-publication-receipt-drift
evals.prompt: Using the provided scenario fixture, respond as the agent handling this request. Do not use live Git or forge tools; give the exact audit route, owner-selection gate, and stopping status.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits publication evidence before selecting a downstream lifecycle owner, treats sequence 8 as authoritative, and stops for inspection because the latest receipt drifts despite an older matching receipt.
expectations: The response invokes audit_reviewable_pr.py audit through publishing-reviewable-prs with the exact current PR identity before lifecycle handoff.
The response does not substitute matching sequence 7 for the authoritative drifting sequence 8.
The response treats drift as evidence requiring inspection and does not replay a completed publication mutation.
The response stops without claiming a successful readiness, feedback, or merge-owner handoff.

evals.name: feedback-terminal-handoff

evals.expected_output: The resume coordinator returns exactly one terminal handoff to addressing-pr-review-feedback and stops; the caller starts that owner separately, and any later lifecycle coordinator begins from freshly read live state.
expectations: The response selects addressing-pr-review-feedback as the only next owner because current actionable feedback outranks readiness.

The response performs no feedback disposition, source revision, interaction, readiness, or merge action.
